SCENE (chosen):

Pose: Rise slightly onto the toes to reach a higher object without changing limb proportions.

Scene: Sunlight falls across an ochre-tiled kitchen; the storage box is a woven basket with a green handle.
Outfit and props: A yellow backless mini dress with a deep side opening at the waist and sage-green piping, exposing back, waist and legs.
Category: Create a sensual but non-explicit everyday lifestyle moment with the same clearly adult character. The situation must read as believable ordinary life, so specify the room, the clothing, and a concrete action already in progress rather than a posed shoot. Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: strong — clearly recognizable source palette and motifs in clothing, not new armor or creature anatomy
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers, the thumb on its inner side, never merged, doubled, mirrored or extra.
